description: Memory upkeep. cleanup: queue likely duplicate, stale and misfiled records. import: a memory export or edited FlowState markdown into review. stale: facts unchecked for 60+ days, and records flagged possibly stale. files_changed: paths you changed; flags records whose file evidence names them. mark_checked: you re-checked one (clears the flag). set_source: correct an origin (user_stated waits for the user). set_aside: no longer applies but kept (needs reason; out of brief and search; restore_set_aside or undo). delete: only when the user asks; undo restores it; with approvals on it waits for the user's approve (manage_review). Requires project. Returns counts and ids.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

days.description: stale: unchecked for this many days. Default 60.

format.description: import: memory (default; one memory per line or bullet) or flowstate_markdown (an edited FlowState markdown export).

kind.description: import (memory format): record kind for each memory. Default learning.

kinds.description: cleanup: which checks. Omit for all three.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

origin.description: import: where it came from, such as Claude or ChatGPT.

paths.description: files_changed (required): the files you changed, repo-relative.

reason.description: set_aside (required): why the record no longer applies.

record_id.description: delete / mark_checked / set_source / set_aside / restore_set_aside: the record's id.

record_type.description: delete / mark_checked / set_source / set_aside / restore_set_aside: the record's type (all but delete: todo, decision, change, learning, problem, variable, method).

source.description: set_source (required) / mark_checked (optional): user_stated, ai_inferred or from_code.

text.description: import: the file contents. Max 200,000 chars.

name: manage_memory
